text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm going to be number one! I'll be number one in both placing and popularity!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of Umamusume you're
going to
see today at this year's Arima
Kinen! I'm off to the
paddock!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet's already heading to the
paddock. She's
really determined...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can see it in her. But as for me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I dunno how to put it. It's kinda
like...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The shape of a dream. Or somethin' like
that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you really think I'm okay the
way I
am?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Goin' up against Scarlet like this is super
fun.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I give it my all in training, raisin' my
speed and
stamina—everything! All so I
can beat her!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I haven't slacked on anything, I'm pretty
sure
about that. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Is my way of life really cool? Is this really what I've been workin' for?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
As things are now, I'm nothin' but a star

Umamusume. I mean, that's great and
all, but isn't
there something more I can
be doing?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's different for Scarlet. That's what
she's workin'
for. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm different? At least, that's
what I've
been thinkin'...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to become the coolest version
of herself,
Vodka has jumped straight
into the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that being weak is lame. But I'm
not sure
if being cool is as simple as just
being strong.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, huh? Yeah, I guess you're
right...
choice_data_list: 有馬が終わったら、考えよう
有馬が終わったら、考えようよ

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's no point dwellin' on it right
before the
year's biggest race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're not wrong about that! This
race is
the climax of the whole year after
all.
choice_data_list: 少なくとも、それはカッコ悪いな
少なくとも、それはカッコ悪いよね

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse, I'm gonna give it my
all! I'm
not leavin' with any regrets!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right. Here I go. I'm sure I'll come
back with my
answer!
